title: Module 2 — Basics: environment, family, objects, and spatial relationships
description: Environment, family, objects, and spatial relationships

topics.title: Family and pets
topics.brief: Family members (pai, mãe, filho/filha, irmão/irmã, avô/avó, tio/tia, primo/prima, marido, mulher, namorado/a) and pets (cão, gato); possessives o meu / a minha / os meus / as minhas; "ter" for having family members; ages of family members.
topics.known: Module 1 — ser/estar/ter, -ar verbs, articles, de/em contractions, numbers to 50, question words.
topics.avoid: past tenses, subjunctive, object pronouns, comparatives.

topics.title: Classroom objects and class communication
topics.brief: Classroom objects (livro, caderno, lápis, borracha, quadro, mesa, cadeira, mochila) and phrases used in class (Posso…?, Não percebo, Pode repetir?, Como se diz … em português?); singular/plural of nouns; polite classroom requests.
topics.known: Module 1 grammar; m2-family-pets possessives. Fixed polite chunks (usable as whole phrases, no poder conjugation): Posso…?, Pode repetir?
topics.avoid: past tenses, subjunctive, object pronouns, comparatives.

topics.title: Regular -er verbs
topics.brief: Presente do Indicativo of regular -er verbs (viver, comer, escrever, beber, aprender, vender); endings -o/-es/-e/-emos/-em; contrast with the -ar endings from Module 1; negation with não.
topics.avoid: past tenses, subjunctive, -ir verbs, object pronouns.

topics.title: Demonstratives and de/em contractions
topics.brief: Invariable demonstratives isto/isso/aquilo and variable este/esta, esse/essa, aquele/aquela with gender/number agreement; contractions of de and em with demonstratives (disto, nisso, daqui, deste, neste); pointing things out (Isto é um livro. / Este livro é meu.).
topics.known: Module 1 — articles, de/em contractions; m2-classroom-objects vocabulary.
topics.avoid: past tenses, subjunctive, comparatives, spatial prepositions (later topic).

topics.title: Appearance, character and physical states
topics.brief: Describing appearance (alto/baixo, gordo/magro, cabelo, olhos azuis, barba) and character (simpático/a, tímido/a, engraçado/a); physiological states with estar/ter (estar cansado, ter fome, ter frio, ter sede, ter sono).
topics.known: Module 1 — ser vs estar, ter, adjective agreement.

topics.title: Colors and antonym pairs
topics.brief: Colors (vermelho, azul, verde, amarelo, preto, branco, cor-de-rosa) with gender/number agreement; common antonym pairs (grande/pequeno, alto/baixo, quente/frio, novo/velho, caro/barato); describing objects and people.

topics.title: Spatial prepositions
topics.brief: Prepositions and phrases of place: dentro de, debaixo de, em cima de, ao lado de, em frente de, atrás de, entre; contraction with articles (dentro do, em cima da); describing where objects or people are in a room or classroom.
topics.known: Module 1 — articles, de/em contractions; m2-classroom-objects, m2-demonstratives.
topics.avoid: past tenses, comparatives, prepositions of movement (a, para, por — later module).

topics.title: Numbers 51–160
topics.brief: Numbers 51–160: cinquenta e um … cento e sessenta; hundred forms (cem vs cento e); prices, quantities and ages beyond 50, building on Module 1 numbers 0–50.
topics.known: Module 1 — numbers 0–50, um/uma and dois/duas agreement.
topics.avoid: past tenses, ordinals beyond sexto, percentages (later module).
